migration_source.fresh_holdout_rule: Games declared in run_manifest.fresh_holdout import zero legacy fields; only canonical central variables are recomputed from raw records.
migration_source.pass_alignment_rule: Whitelisted legacy fields are omitted for a pass and all later moves; canonical fields are rebuilt with correct pass replay.
migration_source.rule: No archive is opened when the frozen concept configuration requires only canonical fields. Otherwise, only whitelisted non-central board-analysis fields are copied; no legacy probe, causal output, or central concept field is read.
